# Widget schema v1 reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo run -p overcrow-widget-schema --example reference`. Do not edit. -->

This reference is generated from the `overcrow-widget-schema` crate, the single source of truth of widget API version 1 (OverCrow design record ADR 0001, D8). The host, the creator CLI and the Studio compile the same tables; anything absent from them is rejected.

**Status.** A *fixed* value is final for v1; the VM budgets come from the P0.3 measurements (ADR 0002) and the parity bounds from the P0.4 text spike (ADR 0003). A *provisional* value is a conservative placeholder until the named lot delivers its evidence: the P2.4 pilots check the light colours; P1.3, P1.6, P1.7 and P1.8 exercise rendering, sandbox, IPC and service bounds. Capabilities, services and write intents follow the P0.6 audit of the built-ins. A provisional value is enforced exactly like a fixed one until it is revised.

Lengths are logical pixels at 100 % content scale. Text limits count UTF-8 bytes unless the unit says characters, which are Unicode scalar values.

## View

`view.ocml` is XML-like markup compiled ahead of time by the CLI: template expressions become code in `logic.js`, and the VM emits scene patches that the host validates against the elements below.

### Template constructs

| Syntax | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `{expr}` | Interpolates an expression into text or an attribute value. |
| `<if test={expr}> … <else-if test={expr}> … <else>` | Conditional subtree. |
| `<for each={expr} as="item" key={expr}>` | Repeats a subtree; `key` is mandatory and must be unique among siblings. |
| `<component name="x" props="a b"> … <slot/> … </component>` | Local component with declared props and one slot, used as `<x a={…}>`. |
| `on:<event>={handler}` | Subscribes the node to an event of its element and names the logic handler. |

Expressions: Literals, state and prop paths, `!`, `&&`, `||`, `??`, comparison and arithmetic operators, the conditional operator, calls to functions exported by the logic module and `t(key, params)` for localized text. No assignment, function literal, `new`, `this`, template literal or access to globals.

### Elements

| Element | Content | Parents | Focus | Role | Events | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `box` | flow | any flow | when subscribed | group | `activate`, `contextmenu`, `wheel`, `keydown`, `focus`, `blur` | Generic container; flex or grid layout comes from style. The scene root (node 0) is a `box`. |
| `scroll` | flow | any flow | never | scroll-view | `reachend`, `contextmenu` | Clipping container scrolled by the host with wheel, drag and keyboard. |
| `list` | flow | any flow | never | list | `reachend`, `contextmenu` | Vertical scrolling list whose children are laid out and painted only when visible. |
| `text` | inline: `span`, `icon`, `image` | any flow | when subscribed | label | `activate`, `contextmenu`, `wheel`, `keydown`, `focus`, `blur` | Block of wrapped text; its inline children flow with it (chat line with emotes). |
| `span` | text | `text` | never | label | none | Styled run of text inside `text`. |
| `icon` | empty | any flow | when subscribed | image | `activate`, `contextmenu`, `wheel`, `keydown`, `focus`, `blur` | Lucide icon tinted with `color`, sized by `font-size` unless `width`/`height` are set. |
| `image` | empty | any flow | when subscribed | image | `activate`, `contextmenu`, `wheel`, `keydown`, `focus`, `blur` | Raster image from the package or a host asset handle; `object-fit` applies. |
| `avatar` | empty | any flow | when subscribed | image | `activate`, `contextmenu`, `wheel`, `keydown`, `focus`, `blur` | Round image with a text fallback while the image is missing or failed. |
| `badge` | text | any flow | when subscribed | label | `activate`, `contextmenu`, `wheel` | Short pill of text. |
| `button` | flow | any flow | always | button | `activate`, `contextmenu`, `wheel`, `keydown`, `focus`, `blur` | Activatable control; its children (icon, text) form its content. |
| `toggle` | empty | any flow | always | switch | `change`, `focus`, `blur`, `contextmenu` | On/off switch. |
| `checkbox` | empty | any flow | always | check-box | `change`, `focus`, `blur`, `contextmenu` | Check control (checklists). |
| `slider` | empty | any flow | always | slider | `input`, `change`, `focus`, `blur`, `contextmenu` | Numeric range control; dragging is resolved in the host. |
| `select` | `option` | any flow | always | combo-box | `change`, `focus`, `blur`, `contextmenu` | Drop-down choice; the open list is drawn by the host. |
| `option` | text | `select` | never | list-box-option | none | Choice of a `select`; its text is the visible label. |
| `field` | empty | any flow | always | text-input | `input`, `change`, `submit`, `keydown`, `focus`, `blur`, `contextmenu` | Single-line text input edited by the host, IME included. |
| `textarea` | empty | any flow | always | multiline-text-input | `input`, `change`, `submit`, `keydown`, `focus`, `blur`, `contextmenu` | Multi-line text input edited by the host, IME included. |
| `form` | flow | any flow | never | form | `submit` | Groups named controls. With `intent`, submitting sends their values to a write service directly from the host; the VM never supplies that body. |
| `elapsed` | empty | any flow | when subscribed | timer | `activate`, `contextmenu`, `wheel` | Duration text advanced by the host from a service anchor, so a running stopwatch needs no VM traffic. Styled like `text`; repainted only when the shown text changes, at most at `ANIMATION_RATE_HZ`, and never while hidden. |
| `progress` | empty | any flow | when subscribed | progress-indicator | `activate`, `contextmenu`, `wheel` | Horizontal progress bar. |
| `gauge` | empty | any flow | when subscribed | meter | `activate`, `contextmenu`, `wheel` | Ring or arc gauge. |
| `chart` | `series` | any flow | when subscribed | figure | `activate`, `contextmenu`, `wheel` | Line, area, bar or sparkline chart drawn by the host. |
| `series` | empty | `chart` | never | figure | none | One data series of a `chart`, coloured with `color`. |
| `separator` | empty | any flow | never | splitter | none | Thin rule between groups. |
| `canvas` | empty | any flow | when subscribed | image | `activate`, `contextmenu`, `wheel`, `keydown`, `focus`, `blur` | Surface painted by the host from the widget's latest `Draw` command list. |
| `popover` | flow | any flow | never | menu | `dismiss` | Floating panel anchored to a node, drawn above the content and clipped to the widget container (drop-downs, context menus). |

#### Attributes of every element

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `class` | class list | no | Style classes. |
| `label` | text ≤ `MAX_LABEL_BYTES` | no | Accessible name; required on icon-only controls. |
| `tooltip` | text ≤ `MAX_LABEL_BYTES` | no | Plain text drawn by the host on hover or focus. |
| `on` | event set | no | Events forwarded to the VM; written `on:<event>` in the view. |

#### `scroll` attributes

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `axis` | `vertical` \| `horizontal` | no | Scroll direction; default `vertical`. |
| `stick-to-end` | boolean | no | Stay at the end while content grows, until the user scrolls away (chat). |

#### `list` attributes

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `stick-to-end` | boolean | no | As for `scroll`. |
| `item-height` | integer 1..=4096 | no | Estimated child height used before a child is first measured. |

#### `text` attributes

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `selectable` | boolean | no | The user can select the text and copy it through the host; no widget permission involved. |

#### `span` attributes

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `color` | `opaque `#rrggbb`` | no | Colour from data, such as a chat author's; overrides the style colour, and the host raises its contrast to at least 4.5:1 against the panel. |

#### `icon` attributes

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | Lucide icon name | yes | Icon name, for example `circle-check`. |

#### `image` attributes

| `disabled` | boolean | no | Rejects input; matches `:disabled`. |

#### `field` attributes

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | text ≤ `MAX_FIELD_TEXT_BYTES` | no | Replaces the content; rejected on a field bound to a write intent. |
| `placeholder` | text ≤ `MAX_LABEL_BYTES` | no | Hint shown while empty. |
| `max-length` | integer 1..=16384 | no | Content limit in bytes; a write intent may impose a lower one. |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | Rejects input; matches `:disabled`. |
| `name` | identifier ≤ `MAX_IDENTIFIER_BYTES` | no | Field name inside a `form`. |

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | text ≤ `MAX_FIELD_TEXT_BYTES` | no | As for `field`. |
| `placeholder` | text ≤ `MAX_LABEL_BYTES` | no | Hint shown while empty. |
| `max-length` | integer 1..=16384 | no | As for `field`. |
| `rows` | integer 1..=40 | no | Visible rows before scrolling; default 3. |
| `disabled` | boolean | no | Rejects input; matches `:disabled`. |
| `name` | identifier ≤ `MAX_IDENTIFIER_BYTES` | no | Field name inside a `form`. |

| `target` | text ≤ `MAX_ATTRIBUTE_TEXT_BYTES` | no | Opaque ID of the edited object (note, reply parent), checked by the service. |

| `format` | `hh:mm:ss` \| `hh:mm:ss.cc` \| `mm:ss` | yes | Hours grow past 99; `cc` are hundredths, truncated. |

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `open` | boolean | no | Visibility; the host closes it and sends `dismiss`. |

### Events

A gesture event authorizes gesture-bound service calls made while the VM handles it, in Interactive mode only.

| Event | Gesture | Detail | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `activate` | yes | `x`, `y` | Primary click, or Enter/Space on the focused node. |
| `contextmenu` | yes | `x`, `y` | Secondary click, Menu key or Shift+F10. |
| `wheel` | no | `dx`, `dy` | Wheel or touchpad scroll over a node that is not a scroll container. |
| `keydown` | yes | `key`, `ctrl`, `alt`, `shift`, `meta`, `repeat` | Key pressed while the node has focus in Interactive mode. Keys reserved by the host (Tab traversal, OverCrow shortcuts, IME composition) are never delivered. |
| `input` | yes | `value` | Value edited (text, slider drag). Read-only copy; the host keeps the content. |
| `change` | yes | `value` | Value committed: blur or Enter for text, release for a slider, any change for toggle, checkbox and select. |
| `submit` | yes | `outcome`, `error` | Form submitted by Enter in a field or a `submit` button. With an intent, carries the service outcome. |
| `focus` | no | none | Node gained keyboard focus. |
| `blur` | no | none | Node lost keyboard focus. |
| `reachend` | no | none | Scrolled within one viewport of the end (load more, history). |
| `dismiss` | no | none | The host closed a popover (Escape, outside click, anchor removed). |

Named `keydown` keys: `Enter`, `Escape`, `Backspace`, `Delete`, `ArrowUp`, `ArrowDown`, `ArrowLeft`, `ArrowRight`, `Home`, `End`, `PageUp`, `PageDown`. Any other `key` is one printable grapheme.

## Style

### Properties

Animatable properties change paint only, so transitions and animations never rerun layout. `text-overflow: marquee` scrolls one overflowing line back and forth at a host-defined speed, pausing at each end; it runs only while the widget is visible, counts as an active animation and restarts when the text changes.

| `display` | Layout | `flex` \| `grid` \| `none` | `flex` | no | no |
| `position` | Layout | `relative` \| `absolute` | `relative` | no | no |
| `top` | Layout | `<px>` \| `<percent>` \| `auto`, negative allowed | `auto` | no | no |
| `right` | Layout | `<px>` \| `<percent>` \| `auto`, negative allowed | `auto` | no | no |
| `bottom` | Layout | `<px>` \| `<percent>` \| `auto`, negative allowed | `auto` | no | no |
| `left` | Layout | `<px>` \| `<percent>` \| `auto`, negative allowed | `auto` | no | no |
| `flex-direction` | Layout | `row` \| `column` \| `row-reverse` \| `column-reverse` | `row` | no | no |
| `flex-wrap` | Layout | `nowrap` \| `wrap` | `nowrap` | no | no |
| `flex-grow` | Layout | number 0..=1000 | `0` | no | no |
| `flex-shrink` | Layout | number 0..=1000 | `1` | no | no |
| `flex-basis` | Layout | `<px>` \| `<percent>` \| `auto` | `auto` | no | no |
| `justify-content` | Layout | `start` \| `end` \| `center` \| `stretch` \| `space-between` \| `space-around` \| `space-evenly` | `start` | no | no |
| `align-items` | Layout | `start` \| `end` \| `center` \| `baseline` \| `stretch` | `stretch` | no | no |
| `align-self` | Layout | `auto` \| `start` \| `end` \| `center` \| `baseline` \| `stretch` | `auto` | no | no |

| `justify-self` | Layout | `auto` \| `start` \| `end` \| `center` \| `stretch` | `auto` | no | no |
| `gap` | Layout | 1–2 × (`<px>` \| `<percent>`) | `0` | no | no |

### Selectors

| Selector | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `text` | Element type; specificity (0, 1). |
| `.name` | Class; specificity (1, 0). |
| `:hover :active :focus :disabled :checked` | State resolved by the host; specificity (1, 0). `:checked` applies to `toggle` and `checkbox`. |
| `a b` | Descendant combinator. |
| `a > b` | Child combinator. |
| `a, b` | Selector list; each selector keeps its own specificity. |

### Values

| Syntax | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `<px>` | `12px`; `0` may omit the unit. Decimal numbers, no exponent. |
| `<percent>` | `50%` of the containing block, as in CSS. |
| `<fr>` | `1fr`, grid tracks only. |
| `<time>` | `120ms` or `0.12s`, 0..=`MAX_ANIMATION_MS`. |
| `<angle>` | `4deg` or `0.5turn`. |
| `<color>` | `#rgb`, `#rgba`, `#rrggbb`, `#rrggbbaa`, `rgb(r g b)`, `rgb(r g b / a)`, `transparent`, `currentColor`, or a colour token. No named colours. |
| `var(--token)` | Design-system token of the expected type, as a whole value or a component of a composite value. No fallback argument; widgets cannot declare custom properties. |
| `<easing>` | `linear`, `ease`, `ease-in`, `ease-out`, `ease-in-out`, `steps(<integer 1..=60>)`. |
| `<direction>` | `normal`, `reverse`, `alternate`. |
| `<fill-mode>` | `none`, `forwards`, `backwards`, `both`. |

### Sheet rules

| Rule | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `cascade` | Higher specificity wins; equal specificity resolves by source order. Inherited properties take the parent's computed value when unset. |
| `@keyframes name { from { … } 50% { … } to { … } }` | The only at-rule. Stops hold only animatable properties. |
| `/* comment */` | Comments are allowed and ignored. |
| `rejected` | `!important`, `@media`, `@import`, `@font-face`, `url()`, `calc()`, custom property declarations, attribute and ID selectors, `*`, sibling combinators, unknown properties or values. Any of them rejects the whole sheet. |

## Icons

Every icon of the pinned `egui-lucide 0.1.0` crate (Lucide 1.34.0, 1777 names) is valid in `icon` elements and `wrapper.menu` rows; any other name is rejected. The crate is the host's only icon source. The exact list is [`icons_generated.rs`](../crates/overcrow-widget-schema/src/icons_generated.rs), regenerated from the crate's name table by `scripts/generate-widget-icons.py`. Within API v1 the set may grow but never loses or renames a name.

## Manifest

`manifest.json` is one strict JSON object: a byte-order mark, a duplicate key, trailing data or an unknown field rejects it, and so does any Web API manifest. The format of the package that carries it is in [Package](#package) and [`widget-package-v1.md`](widget-package-v1.md).

### `manifest.json`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `schemaVersion` | integer 1..=1 | yes | Manifest document version. |
| `apiVersion` | integer 1..=1 | yes | Widget API version; selects this schema. |
| `id` | `widget ID` | yes | Reverse-DNS ID, `MIN_WIDGET_ID_BYTES`..=`MAX_WIDGET_ID_BYTES`: at least two dot-separated segments of `[a-z0-9-]`, each at most 63 bytes and not starting or ending with `-`. `com.playervox` and `com.playervox.*` are reserved for packages signed by PlayerVox. |
| `version` | `version` | yes | SemVer 2.0.0 `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH[-PRERELEASE]` in canonical form, at most `MAX_VERSION_BYTES`; build metadata is rejected. |
| `name` | `WidgetName` | yes | Localized widget name shown by the host. |
| `sizing` | `Sizing` | yes | Size and fit rules applied by the wrapper. |
| `vm` | `VmRequest` | no | VM budget request; absent means the defaults. |
| `permissions` | `Permissions` | no | Requested permissions; absent means none. |
| `wrapper` | `wrapper` | no | Widget rows of the host options menu. |

### `WidgetName`

Each text is non-empty, trimmed, without control characters and at most `MAX_WIDGET_NAME_CHARS` characters.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `en` | `name text` | yes | English name. |
| `fr` | `name text` | yes | French name. |

### `Sizing`

`min` ≤ `preferred` ≤ `max` on both axes.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fit` | `none` \| `both` \| `height` | yes | Content fitting the widget supports: `both` axes, `height` only, or `none`. Manual resizing is always available. |
| `defaultMode` | `fit` \| `manual` | no | Mode of a new layout; default `fit` when `fit` is not `none`, else `manual`. `fit` with `fit: none` is rejected. |
| `preferred` | `Dimensions` | yes | Initial size; within `min` and `max`. |
| `min` | `Dimensions` | yes | Smallest size. |
| `max` | `Dimensions` | yes | Largest size. |

### `Dimensions`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `width` | integer 1..=4096 | yes | Logical px. |
| `height` | integer 1..=4096 | yes | Logical px. |

### `VmRequest`

A widget that needs more than the default heap requests it here; nothing else about the VM budgets can be changed by a manifest.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `heapMiB` | integer 16..=48 | yes | QuickJS heap ceiling in MiB, from `VM_HEAP_BYTES` to `VM_MAX_HEAP_BYTES`. The VM process ceiling (`VM_PROCESS_MEMORY_BYTES`) does not change. |

### `Permissions`

Keys are the permissions of [Permissions](#permissions); a sensitive capability rejects `network` rules and `clipboardWrite: true`.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `network` | list of `NetworkRule` ≤ `MAX_NETWORK_RULES` | no | Distinct network rules. |
| `storage` | boolean | no | Host key-value storage; default `false`. |
| `clipboardWrite` | boolean | no | Clipboard text writes; default `false`. |
| `gameEvents` | list of `game event` ≤ `MAX_GAME_EVENTS` | no | Distinct `overcrow.game.<name>.v1` event names. |
| `capabilities` | `capability names` | no | Distinct capabilities of the schema. |

## Wrapper menu

The manifest `wrapper` object extends the host options menu (ADR 0001, D12). Host rows (opacity, scale, fit to content, passive visibility) come first, are separated and are not declared here. Widget rows only set a declared value or emit a declared event: they cannot change a grant, open a URL or act as the gesture of a write intent. Values are stored by the host profile store and reach the VM in `Init` and `Snapshot` after durable acknowledgement.

### `wrapper`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `menu` | list of `MenuRow` ≤ `MAX_MENU_ROWS` | no | Widget rows in display order. |

### Fields of every row

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `type` | `toggle` \| `slider` \| `choice` \| `action` \| `group` | yes | Row type. |
| `id` | identifier ≤ `MAX_MENU_ID_BYTES` | yes | Unique among all rows of the widget; key of the stored value. |
| `label` | `MenuLabel` | yes | Localized row label. |
| `icon` | Lucide icon name | no | Leading icon from the host list, drawn by the host. |
| `visibleWhen` | identifier ≤ `MAX_MENU_ID_BYTES` | no | ID of a `toggle` row declared earlier; this row is shown only while that toggle is on. |
| `requires` | `fps` \| `telemetry.cpuTemperature` \| `telemetry.gpuTemperature` | no | Host data source; the host hides the row when it cannot supply it. |

### Row types

#### `toggle`

Boolean switch.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | boolean | yes | Initial value. |

#### `slider`

Bounded number; `step` > 0, `step` ≤ `max - min`, at most `MAX_SLIDER_STEPS` steps, `default` within range.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min` | number -1000000..=1000000 | yes | Lower bound. |
| `max` | number -1000000..=1000000 | yes | Upper bound, greater than `min`. |
| `step` | number -1000000..=1000000 | yes | Increment. |
| `default` | number -1000000..=1000000 | yes | Initial value. |

#### `choice`

One value among declared choices.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `choices` | list of `MenuChoice` ≤ `MAX_MENU_CHOICES` | yes | At least `MIN_MENU_CHOICES` choices. |
| `default` | identifier ≤ `MAX_MENU_ID_BYTES` | yes | Value of one declared choice. |

#### `action`

Sends a `menu` event carrying the row ID to the VM. Not a user gesture.

#### `group`

Side flyout holding non-group rows.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rows` | list of `MenuRow` ≤ `MAX_MENU_ROWS` | yes | At least one row; a `group` is not allowed here. |

### `MenuLabel`

Each text is non-empty, trimmed, without control characters and at most `MAX_MENU_LABEL_CHARS` characters.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `en` | `label text` | yes | English label. |
| `fr` | `label text` | yes | French label. |

### `MenuChoice`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | identifier ≤ `MAX_MENU_ID_BYTES` | yes | Stored value; unique within the row. |
| `label` | `MenuLabel` | yes | Localized choice label. |

## Permissions

Declaring a permission or capability grants nothing: activation requires consent recorded by the host.

| Permission | With a sensitive capability | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `network` | manifest rejected | Exact HTTPS routes reachable through the host broker, at most `MAX_NETWORK_RULES` rules. |
| `storage` | process-lifetime data only | Host-managed key-value storage partitioned by widget ID, within `STORAGE_QUOTA_BYTES`. |
| `clipboardWrite` | manifest rejected | Text clipboard writes on a current Interactive gesture. |
| `gameEvents` | allowed | Named semantic game events `overcrow.game.<name>.v1`, at most `MAX_GAME_EVENTS`. |
| `capabilities` | allowed | Host services listed below. |

### Network rules

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `origin` | `origin` | yes | Canonical `https://host[:port]` origin; no credentials, IP literal or local name. |
| `method` | `GET` \| `POST` \| `PUT` \| `PATCH` \| `DELETE` | yes | One method. |
| `path` | text ≤ `MAX_NETWORK_PATH_BYTES` | yes | Complete path; `{name}` segments are typed path parameters. |
| `pathParams` | `name → ParameterConstraint` | no | Constraint of every `{name}` segment, at most `MAX_PATH_PARAMS`. |
| `queryParams` | `name → ParameterConstraint` | no | Allowed query parameters, at most `MAX_QUERY_PARAMS`, each optionally `required`; others are refused. |

### `ParameterConstraint` types

| Type | Shape | Accepts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `integer` | `{ min, max }` | Decimal without leading zero, 0..=2^53 - 1. |
| `slug` | `{ maxLength }` | `[a-z0-9-]`, not starting or ending with `-`. |
| `enum` | list of `literal segment` ≤ `MAX_ENUM_VALUES` | One of the listed values, each ≤ `MAX_ENUM_VALUE_BYTES`. |
| `string` | `{ maxLength }` | Query parameters only; any text without control characters. |

### Capabilities

| Capability | Sensitive | Account | Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `telemetry.read` | no | none | fixed | CPU, RAM and temperature samples of the active game. |
| `fps.read` | no | none | fixed | Frame rate of the active game when the host has a source. |
| `media.read` | yes | none | fixed | Now-playing metadata and cover art handle. |
| `media.control` | yes | none | fixed | Previous, play/pause and next. |
| `session.read` | no | none | fixed | Duration of the active game session, without the game identity. |
| `stopwatch.read` | no | none | fixed | State of the host's single manual stopwatch and its shortcuts. |
| `stopwatch.control` | no | none | fixed | Start, pause and reset the host's single manual stopwatch. |
| `notes.read` | yes | none | fixed | The user's notes and checklists: one document shared by every game. |
| `notes.write` | yes | none | fixed | Create, select, save, check and delete notes; text only through host-bound intents. |
| `playervox.score.read` | yes | none | fixed | Public PlayerVox score of the active game; sensitive because it reveals the game. |
| `playervox.rating.read` | yes | PlayerVox | fixed | The user's own rating of the active game. |
| `playervox.rating.write` | yes | PlayerVox | fixed | Publish a rating and review through a host-bound intent. |
| `playervox.reviews.read` | yes | PlayerVox | fixed | Paged player reviews of the active game, optionally from followed players only. |
| `journal.read` | yes | none | fixed | Play sessions of the active game: local ones, plus cloud ones while PlayerVox is connected. |
| `journal.delete` | yes | none | fixed | Delete a journal session after native confirmation; cloud rows need PlayerVox. |
| `twitch.chat.read` | yes | Twitch | fixed | Join, read and leave a Twitch channel chat, and keep favourite channels. |
| `twitch.chat.compose` | yes | Twitch | fixed | Send a chat message through a host-bound intent; the host allows 20 messages per 30 s and answers `busy` beyond. |

## Services

Authority is checked by the host at every call, immediately before acting. Gesture services also require the `cause` of a gesture event of the current Interactive epoch.

| Service | Requires | Kind | Gesture | Confirmation | Parameters | Result | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `subscription.cancel` | nothing | call | no | no | `call`: id | `null` | fixed |
| `timer.start` | nothing | call | no | no | `timer`: id; `intervalMs`: integer 100..=86400000; `repeat`: boolean | `null`; ticks arrive as `timer` events, never while hidden | fixed |
| `timer.cancel` | nothing | call | no | no | `timer`: id | `null` | fixed |
| `storage.get` | permission `storage` | call | no | no | `key`: text ≤ `MAX_STORAGE_KEY_BYTES` | stored JSON value or `null` | fixed |
| `storage.set` | permission `storage` | call | no | no | `key`: text ≤ `MAX_STORAGE_KEY_BYTES`; `value`: JSON | `null`; `quota_exceeded` beyond `STORAGE_QUOTA_BYTES` | fixed |
| `storage.remove` | permission `storage` | call | no | no | `key`: text ≤ `MAX_STORAGE_KEY_BYTES` | `null` | fixed |
| `storage.keys` | permission `storage` | call | no | no | none | list of keys | fixed |
| `http.fetch` | permission `network` | call | no | no | `url`: text ≤ `MAX_REQUEST_URL_BYTES`; `method`: `GET` \| `POST` \| `PUT` \| `PATCH` \| `DELETE`; `contentType?`: `application/json` \| `text/plain`; `as`: `json` \| `text` \| `bytes` \| `image` | `{ status, contentType }` with the body as raw payload ≤ `MAX_HTTP_RESPONSE_BYTES`, or `{ status, asset }` | fixed |
| `clipboard.writeText` | permission `clipboardWrite` | call | yes | no | `text`: text ≤ `MAX_CLIPBOARD_BYTES` | `null` | fixed |
| `gameEvents.subscribe` | permission `gameEvents` | subscribe | no | no | none | `{ event, at }` for each declared event | fixed |
| `session.subscribe` | capability `session.read` | subscribe | no | no | none | `{ elapsedMs, at }` counted from the start of the game process, or `null` without an active game | fixed |
| `telemetry.subscribe` | capability `telemetry.read` | subscribe | no | no | none | `{ cpu, ram, cpuTemperature, gpuTemperature, sources }`, or `null` without an active game: `cpu` is the game's share of the whole machine in % (0–100), `ram` its resident bytes, temperatures are °C or `null`, `sources` `{ cpuTemperature, gpuTemperature }` says whether the host has each sensor | fixed |
| `fps.subscribe` | capability `fps.read` | subscribe | no | no | none | `{ fps, stale, status }`: `fps` a number or `null`; the host sets `stale` 3 s after the last sample; `status` is `ready`, `waiting`, `unsupported`, `permission_denied`, `ambiguous`, `events_lost` or `unavailable` | fixed |
| `media.subscribe` | capability `media.read` | subscribe | no | no | `cover?`: boolean | `null` without a player, or `{ player, title, artists, playing, canPrevious, canPlayPause, canNext, cover }`: `player` an opaque ID, `artists` a list, `cover` an `asset:` handle of at most 512 px or `null` | fixed |
| `media.previous` | capability `media.control` | call | yes | no | `player?`: text ≤ `MAX_OBJECT_ID_BYTES` | `null`; `stale_context` when `player` is no longer current | fixed |
| `media.playPause` | capability `media.control` | call | yes | no | `player?`: text ≤ `MAX_OBJECT_ID_BYTES` | `null`; `stale_context` when `player` is no longer current | fixed |
| `media.next` | capability `media.control` | call | yes | no | `player?`: text ≤ `MAX_OBJECT_ID_BYTES` | `null`; `stale_context` when `player` is no longer current | fixed |
| `stopwatch.subscribe` | capability `stopwatch.read` | subscribe | no | no | none | `{ running, elapsedMs, at, shortcuts }`, or `null` without an active game; `shortcuts` `{ toggle, reset, bound }` holds host-formatted key chords | fixed |
| `stopwatch.toggle` | capability `stopwatch.control` | call | yes | no | none | the new state, as in `stopwatch.subscribe`; `unavailable` when the host cannot act | fixed |
| `stopwatch.reset` | capability `stopwatch.control` | call | yes | no | none | the new state, as in `stopwatch.subscribe`; `unavailable` when the host cannot act | fixed |
| `notes.subscribe` | capability `notes.read` | subscribe | no | no | none | `{ active, notes }` of the user's single notes document; each note `{ id, title, body, items }`, each item `{ id, text, checked }` | fixed |
| `notes.create` | capability `notes.write` | call | yes | no | none | `{ note }`, a new empty active note titled `Note {n}` in the user's language; `quota_exceeded` beyond `MAX_NOTES` | fixed |
| `notes.select` | capability `notes.write` | call | yes | no | `note`: text ≤ `MAX_OBJECT_ID_BYTES` | `null`; the host stores the active note | fixed |
| `notes.setItem` | capability `notes.write` | call | yes | no | `note`: text ≤ `MAX_OBJECT_ID_BYTES`; `item`: text ≤ `MAX_OBJECT_ID_BYTES`; `checked`: boolean | `null` | fixed |
| `notes.delete` | capability `notes.write` | call | yes | yes | `note`: text ≤ `MAX_OBJECT_ID_BYTES` | `null`, or `cancelled` when the user declines | fixed |
| `playervox.score.subscribe` | capability `playervox.score.read` | subscribe | no | no | none | `{ state, name, score, grade, ratingsCount, criteria }`: `state` is `ready`, `no_ratings`, `not_found` or `unavailable`; `criteria` `{ gameplay, art, tech }`, each 0–100 or `null` | fixed |
| `playervox.rating.subscribe` | capability `playervox.rating.read` | subscribe | no | no | none | `null` before the user's first rating, or `{ gameplay, art, tech, review, publishedAt, offsetMinutes }`; `unsupported` outside the PlayerVox catalogue; the host seeds the `playervox.rating.publish` controls from it | fixed |
| `playervox.reviews.page` | capability `playervox.reviews.read` | call | no | no | `page?`: integer 1..=100000; `followedOnly?`: boolean | `{ items, page, totalPages, count }`; each item `{ id, author, grade, score, text, original, publishedAt, offsetMinutes }`, `text` in the user's language when a translation exists, `original` the untranslated text or `null`, both cut by the host to `MAX_NODE_TEXT_BYTES` | fixed |
| `journal.page` | capability `journal.read` | call | no | no | `cursor?`: text ≤ `MAX_OBJECT_ID_BYTES` | `{ gameName, items, next, previous }`: local and cloud sessions of the active game, merged and deduplicated, newest first; each item `{ id, startedAt, offsetMinutes, durationMs, source }`; cursors are host handles | fixed |
| `journal.delete` | capability `journal.delete` | call | yes | yes | `session`: text ≤ `MAX_OBJECT_ID_BYTES` | `null`, or `cancelled` when the user declines; `not_connected` for a cloud session while PlayerVox is disconnected | fixed |
| `twitch.chat.subscribe` | capability `twitch.chat.read` | subscribe | no | no | none | `{ account, channel, joinState, favorites, canSend, generation, reset, messages, removed }`: `account` is `signed_out`, `pending`, `connected` or `expired` (sign-in is host chrome); messages arrive as deltas, with `reset` after subscribing, a generation change or a show; each message `{ id, author, color, badges, fragments, reply, deleted }` with at most `MAX_CHAT_FRAGMENTS` fragments, emotes and badges as `asset:` handles for the current theme and scale | fixed |
| `twitch.chat.join` | capability `twitch.chat.read` | call | yes | no | `channel`: text ≤ `MAX_CHAT_CHANNEL_BYTES` | `null`; the host remembers the channel and rejoins it when the widget starts | fixed |
| `twitch.chat.leave` | capability `twitch.chat.read` | call | yes | no | none | `null`; the host forgets the channel | fixed |
| `twitch.chat.favorite` | capability `twitch.chat.read` | call | yes | no | `channel`: text ≤ `MAX_CHAT_CHANNEL_BYTES`; `favorite`: boolean | `null`; `quota_exceeded` beyond `MAX_CHAT_FAVORITES` | fixed |

Service error codes: `invalid_request`, `permission_denied`, `gesture_required`, `not_connected`, `stale_context`, `unavailable`, `busy`, `cancelled`, `quota_exceeded`, `unsupported`, `url_invalid`, `resolve_failed`, `address_denied`, `too_many_addresses`, `peer_mismatch`, `redirect_denied`, `encoding_denied`, `content_type_denied`, `response_metadata_limit`, `request_body_limit`, `response_body_limit`, `image_invalid`, `timeout`, `transport_failed`.

### Write intents

A `form` with an `intent` sends the values of its named host-owned controls straight to the service when the user submits it; the VM receives a `submit` event with the outcome but never supplies the body. Named controls not listed are rejected.

#### `notes.save`

Capability `notes.write`; `target` attribute required (note ID; the host seeds the bound controls from that note). Status: fixed.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | text ≤ `MAX_NOTE_TITLE_BYTES` | yes | `field`. |
| `body` | text ≤ `MAX_NOTE_BODY_BYTES` | no | `textarea`. |
| `item` | list of `NoteItem` ≤ `MAX_NOTE_ITEMS` | no | One `field` per checklist item, in order, each ≤ `MAX_NOTE_ITEM_BYTES`. |

#### `playervox.rating.publish`

Capability `playervox.rating.write`; `target` attribute refused. Status: fixed.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gameplay` | integer 0..=100 | yes | `slider`. |
| `art` | integer 0..=100 | yes | `slider`. |
| `tech` | integer 0..=100 | yes | `slider`. |
| `review` | text ≤ `MAX_REVIEW_CHARS` | no | `textarea`. |

#### `twitch.chat.send`

Capability `twitch.chat.compose`; `target` attribute optional (ID of the message replied to). Status: fixed.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | text ≤ `MAX_CHAT_MESSAGE_CHARS` | yes | `field`; the host clears it after a successful send. |

## IPC

OCWV v1 runs over one inherited pipe or socket pair per widget; the VM never opens or names an endpoint. Each frame is a 32-byte big-endian header, a bounded JSON control part and an optional raw payload.

| Offset | Bytes | Field | Rule |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 4 | magic | `OCWV`. |
| 4 | 2 | version | `1`. |
| 6 | 1 | kind | A frame kind of the sending direction. |
| 7 | 1 | reserved | `0`. |
| 8 | 8 | sequence | Starts at 1 and increases by exactly 1 per frame in each direction. |
| 16 | 4 | json length | ≤ `MAX_CONTROL_JSON_BYTES`. |
| 20 | 4 | raw length | ≤ the raw limit of the frame kind; `0` when it has none. |
| 24 | 4 | reserved | `0` (surface width in the Web API). |
| 28 | 4 | reserved | `0` (surface height in the Web API). |

### Frame kinds

| Code | Name | Direction | Raw payload | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `host-control` | host → VM | none | One control message. |
| 2 | `vm-control` | VM → host | none | One control message. |
| 3 | `host-init` | host → VM | ≤ `MAX_LOGIC_BYTES` | `Init`; raw payload is the ledger-checked `logic.js`. Always the first host frame, sent once. |
| 4 | `host-service-result` | host → VM | ≤ `MAX_HTTP_RESPONSE_BYTES` | `ServiceResult`; raw payload is an HTTP response body when one is returned. |
| 5 | `vm-service-call` | VM → host | ≤ `MAX_HTTP_REQUEST_BYTES` | `ServiceCall`; raw payload is an HTTP request body when one is sent. |
| 6 | `vm-scene-patch` | VM → host | ≤ `MAX_PATCH_BYTES` | `ScenePatch`; raw payload holds the operations. |
| 7 | `vm-draw` | VM → host | ≤ `MAX_PATCH_BYTES` | `Draw`; raw payload holds the command list. |

Raw payload encoding (fixed): UTF-8 JSON: an array of operation objects for `ScenePatch`, an array of command arrays `[name, …arguments]` for `Draw`.

### Host → VM messages

#### `Init` (frame 3)

Starts the VM. The VM answers `Ready` within `VM_READY_TIMEOUT_MS`.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apiVersion` | integer 1..=1 | yes | Widget API version. |
| `generation` | id | yes | VM generation; results of older generations are dropped. |
| `locale` | `en` \| `fr` | yes | Active locale. |
| `messages` | `locale messages` | yes | Messages of the active locale. |
| `view` | `compiled view` | yes | The package's `view.json`, validated by the host at activation. |
| `theme` | `dark` \| `light` | yes | Active theme. |
| `region` | `Region` | yes | Regional formats, as in the `Region` message. |
| `scale` | integer 500..=1750 | yes | Content scale in ‰. |
| `viewport` | `{ width, height }` | yes | Content rectangle, logical px. |
| `mode` | `passive` \| `interactive` | yes | Overlay mode. |
| `visible` | boolean | yes | Whether the widget is shown. |
| `options` | `menu values` | yes | Durable `wrapper.menu` values by row ID. |
| `grants` | `capability names` | yes | Consented capabilities. |

#### `Event` (frame 1)

Input, menu action or timer tick. A gesture event's frame sequence is the only gesture token.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `target` | `node` \| `menu` \| `timer` | yes | Event source. |
| `node` | node reference | no | `node`: subscribed node. |
| `event` | `event name` | no | `node`: one of the node's events. |
| `detail` | JSON | no | `node`: event detail. |
| `row` | `menu row ID` | no | `menu`: `action` row. |
| `timer` | id | no | `timer`: timer ID. |

#### `ServiceResult` (frame 4)

Answer or update of a service call.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call` | id | yes | `callId` of the call. |
| `final` | boolean | yes | `false` for subscription updates. |
| `outcome` | `success` \| `failure` | yes | Outcome. |
| `value` | JSON | no | Success value. |
| `error` | `ServiceError` | no | Failure code. |

#### `Snapshot` (frame 1)

Latest host state after a change, coalesced.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `viewport` | `{ width, height }` | yes | Content rectangle. |
| `scale` | integer 500..=1750 | yes | Content scale. |
| `mode` | `passive` \| `interactive` | yes | Overlay mode. |
| `options` | `menu values` | yes | Durable menu values. |

#### `Visibility` (frame 1)

A hidden VM keeps its state and receives no timer ticks or animation frames.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `visible` | boolean | yes | Shown or hidden. |

#### `Locale` (frame 1)

Locale change.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `locale` | `en` \| `fr` | yes | New locale. |
| `messages` | `locale messages` | yes | Its messages. |

#### `Theme` (frame 1)

Theme change; token values are resolved by the host.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `theme` | `dark` \| `light` | yes | New theme. |

#### `Region` (frame 1)

Regional formats and time zone. The SDK formats numbers, dates and times from them; timestamps in service results carry their own offset.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `numberFormat` | `us` \| `fr` \| `de` | yes | User preference, independent of the locale: `us` 1,234.5 (default), `fr` 1 234,5, `de` 1.234,5. |
| `dateOrder` | `mdy` \| `dmy` \| `ymd` | yes | User preference for numeric dates; the default follows the locale (`en` `mdy`, `fr` `dmy`). |
| `offsetMinutes` | integer -840..=840 | yes | Current UTC offset of the user's time zone; VM local time is UTC (ADR 0002). |
| `nextChangeAt` | integer 0..=9007199254740991 | no | Unix milliseconds of the next offset change; the host sends a new `Region` then. |

#### `Heartbeat` (frame 1)

Sent every `HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS`.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nonce` | id | yes | Echoed by `HeartbeatAck`. |

#### `Shutdown` (frame 1)

Graceful stop; the host kills the process after a bounded delay.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reason` | `closed` \| `disabled` \| `revoked` \| `updated` \| `game_ended` \| `host_exit` | yes | Reason. |

### VM → host messages

#### `Ready` (frame 2)

Initialization finished; the first `ScenePatch` may follow.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `apiVersion` | integer 1..=1 | yes | Must equal `Init`. |
| `sdk` | `semver` | yes | Embedded SDK version. |

#### `ScenePatch` (frame 6)

Atomic: validated in full against the resulting scene before it is applied.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ops` | integer 1..=4096 | yes | Number of operations in the raw payload. |

#### `ServiceCall` (frame 5)

Requests a host service; authority is checked by the host at each call.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `call` | id | yes | Strictly increasing per VM. |
| `service` | `service name` | yes | A service of the schema. |
| `params` | JSON | yes | Parameters of that service. |
| `cause` | id | no | Sequence of the host frame carrying the gesture event being handled; required by gesture services. |

#### `Draw` (frame 7)

Replaces the canvas command list.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `canvas` | node reference | yes | Target `canvas` node. |
| `commands` | integer 0..=4096 | yes | Commands in the raw payload. |

#### `Log` (frame 2)

Development sessions only; production hosts drop it unread.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `level` | `debug` \| `info` \| `warn` \| `error` | yes | Level. |
| `text` | text ≤ `MAX_LOG_BYTES` | yes | Message. |

#### `HeartbeatAck` (frame 2)

Missing it within `HEARTBEAT_DEADLINE_MS` is `unresponsive`.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `nonce` | id | yes | Nonce of the latest `Heartbeat`. |

### Scene patch operations

#### `create` (frame 6)

Adds a node.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | id | yes | New node ID. |
| `parent` | node reference | yes | Parent accepting this element. |
| `index` | integer 0..=1024 | yes | Position among siblings. |
| `element` | `element name` | yes | Element. |
| `attrs` | `attribute map` | no | Initial attributes. |
| `text` | text ≤ `MAX_NODE_TEXT_BYTES` | no | Text of a text-content element. |

#### `remove` (frame 6)

Removes a subtree.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | node reference | yes | Node; its subtree is removed. |

#### `move` (frame 6)

Reorders or reparents a node (keyed lists).

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | node reference | yes | Node. |
| `parent` | node reference | yes | New parent, not inside the node. |
| `index` | integer 0..=1024 | yes | Position among siblings. |

#### `setAttrs` (frame 6)

Changes attributes, classes (`class`) and subscriptions (`on`).

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | node reference | yes | Node. |
| `attrs` | `attribute map` | yes | `null` removes an attribute. |

#### `setText` (frame 6)

Replaces text content.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `node` | node reference | yes | Text-content node. |
| `text` | text ≤ `MAX_NODE_TEXT_BYTES` | yes | Text. |

### Draw commands

Each command is `[name, …arguments]` in order.

| Command | Arguments | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `moveTo` | `x`: number -16384..=16384; `y`: number -16384..=16384 | Starts a subpath. |
| `lineTo` | `x`: number -16384..=16384; `y`: number -16384..=16384 | Straight segment. |
| `quadTo` | `cx`: number -16384..=16384; `cy`: number -16384..=16384; `x`: number -16384..=16384; `y`: number -16384..=16384 | Quadratic Bézier segment. |
| `cubicTo` | `c1x`: number -16384..=16384; `c1y`: number -16384..=16384; `c2x`: number -16384..=16384; `c2y`: number -16384..=16384; `x`: number -16384..=16384; `y`: number -16384..=16384 | Cubic Bézier segment. |
| `arc` | `cx`: number -16384..=16384; `cy`: number -16384..=16384; `r`: number -16384..=16384; `start`: number -720..=720; `end`: number -720..=720 | Circular arc in degrees, clockwise. |
| `rect` | `x`: number -16384..=16384; `y`: number -16384..=16384; `w`: number -16384..=16384; `h`: number -16384..=16384; `radius`: number -16384..=16384 | Closed rounded-rectangle subpath. |
| `circle` | `cx`: number -16384..=16384; `cy`: number -16384..=16384; `r`: number -16384..=16384 | Closed circle subpath. |
| `close` | none | Closes the subpath. |
| `fill` | `color`: `<color>` | Fills and clears the current path. |
| `stroke` | `color`: `<color>`; `width`: number 0..=256 | Strokes and clears the current path. |
| `text` | `x`: number -16384..=16384; `y`: number -16384..=16384; `text`: text ≤ `MAX_ATTRIBUTE_TEXT_BYTES`; `size`: number 6..=96; `color`: `<color>`; `align`: `start` \| `center` \| `end`; `family`: `ui` \| `mono` \| `display`; `weight`: `400` \| `500` \| `600` \| `700` | One line of text on its baseline. |
| `image` | `src`: image source; `x`: number -16384..=16384; `y`: number -16384..=16384; `w`: number -16384..=16384; `h`: number -16384..=16384 | Draws an image scaled into the rectangle. |
| `save` | none | Pushes transform, clip and alpha, ≤ `MAX_DRAW_STATE_DEPTH`. |
| `restore` | none | Pops the state; unbalanced is a violation. |
| `clip` | `x`: number -16384..=16384; `y`: number -16384..=16384; `w`: number -16384..=16384; `h`: number -16384..=16384 | Intersects the clip rectangle. |
| `translate` | `x`: number -16384..=16384; `y`: number -16384..=16384 | Translates. |
| `rotate` | `degrees`: number -360..=360 | Rotates. |
| `scale` | `x`: number 0..=8; `y`: number 0..=8 | Scales. |
| `alpha` | `value`: number 0..=1 | Multiplies opacity. |

### Failure categories

| Category | Restarts | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `invalid_bundle` | no | Package, ledger or compiled content rejected. |
| `permission_denied` | no | Declared, consented and requested authority disagree. |
| `protocol_violation` | no | Malformed, unknown or out-of-order IPC or scene data. |
| `resource_limit` | yes | A memory, CPU, queue, rate or size ceiling was exceeded. |
| `unresponsive` | yes | Missed `Ready` or heartbeat deadline, or turn budget exceeded. |
| `vm_exited` | yes | The VM process ended unexpectedly. |

Transient failures restart after 1, 5 and 15 seconds, at most three times; the budget resets after 60 seconds of stable run.

## Package

A `.ocpkg` v1 archive is a stored (uncompressed) zip in one pinned layout, so identical files give identical bytes and the archive digest identifies the content. [`widget-package-v1.md`](widget-package-v1.md) specifies the layout, the ledger, admission and the catalog flow.

### Files

Any other entry rejects the package.

| Path | Required | Limit | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `manifest.json` | yes | `MAX_MANIFEST_BYTES` | Manifest v1, as authored. |
| `ledger.json` | yes | `MAX_LEDGER_BYTES` | Canonical SHA-256 and byte ledger of every other entry, written by the CLI. |
| `logic.js` | yes | `MAX_LOGIC_BYTES` | The only executable content: one ES2023 script without imports, compiled template expressions included. UTF-8, not empty. |
| `view.json` | yes | `MAX_COMPILED_VIEW_BYTES` | Compiled view. The `view.ocml` source is not shipped. |
| `style.ocss` | no | `MAX_STYLE_SOURCE_BYTES` | Style sheet source, parsed by the host at activation. UTF-8. |
| `locales/en.json` | no | `MAX_LOCALE_FILE_BYTES` | English messages; present if and only if `locales/fr.json` is, with the same keys. |
| `locales/fr.json` | no | `MAX_LOCALE_FILE_BYTES` | French messages. |
| `LICENSE` | yes | `MAX_LICENSE_BYTES` | License text of the package. UTF-8, not empty. |
| `assets/<path>.{png,jpg,jpeg,webp}` | no | `MAX_IMAGE_ENCODED_BYTES` | Images whose signature matches the extension; lowercase `[a-z0-9_-]` segments, at most `MAX_ASSET_PATH_SEGMENTS` below `assets/`. |

### Compiled view `view.json`

The CLI compiles `view.ocml` into this tree and every template expression and handler into a function of `logic.js`; the tree refers to them by index. The host validates it at activation and sends it to the VM in `Init`.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `viewFormat` | integer 1..=1 | yes | Compiled view format. |
| `expressions` | integer 0..=4096 | yes | Length of the expression table `logic.js` registers; every expression index is below it. |
| `components` | list of `Component` ≤ `MAX_COMPONENTS` | no | Local components. |
| `children` | list of `Node` ≤ `MAX_CHILDREN` | yes | Children of the scene root, a `box` (node 0). |

#### `Component`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | identifier ≤ `MAX_IDENTIFIER_BYTES` | yes | Unique; not an element name. |
| `props` | list of `scope name` ≤ `MAX_COMPONENT_PROPS` | yes | Distinct prop names. |
| `children` | list of `Node` ≤ `MAX_CHILDREN` | yes | Body, laid out where the component is used; flow content with at most one `slot`. |

#### Nodes

A node is an object recognised by one discriminating key. Scope names are `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` within `MAX_IDENTIFIER_BYTES`; expression indices are below `expressions`.

##### `element`

An element of the schema. `text` holds the content of a text or inline element; an inline element has `text` or inline `children`, not both.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `element` | `element name` | yes | Element. |
| `attrs` | `attribute map` | no | Static attributes, checked against the element's types; `assets/…` images must be in the package. |
| `bind` | `attribute → expression index` | no | Attributes computed by the VM; checked in every patch. |
| `on` | `event → expression index` | no | Events of the element and their handlers. |
| `text` | `list of Part` | no | Text content: literal strings and `{ "expr": n }` parts. |
| `children` | list of `Node` ≤ `MAX_CHILDREN` | no | Child nodes, checked against the element's content model. |

##### `if`

Conditional subtree: branches `{ "test": n, "children": […] }`; only the last may omit `test` (the `else`).

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `if` | `list of Branch` | yes | At least one branch. |

##### `for`

Repeats `children` for each item of the list expression.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `for` | `expression index` | yes | List expression. |
| `as` | `scope name` | yes | Item name in scope. |
| `key` | `expression index` | yes | Mandatory key expression, unique among siblings at runtime. |
| `children` | list of `Node` ≤ `MAX_CHILDREN` | yes | Repeated nodes. |

##### `component`

Use of a local component; allowed where flow content is.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `component` | `component name` | yes | Component. |
| `props` | `prop → expression index` | no | Declared props only. |
| `children` | list of `Node` ≤ `MAX_CHILDREN` | no | Content placed at the component's `slot`. |

##### `slot`

Where a component places the children of its use; only in a component body, in flow content.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `slot` | `true` | yes | Always `true`. |

## Catalog

The v1 catalog is `https://overcrow.playervox.com/marketplace/widgets/v1/catalog.json`. Its envelope carries an Ed25519 signature of the domain string `OverCrow widget catalog v1\0` followed by the payload bytes; the offline seed uses `OverCrow widget seed v1\0`. `\0` is one NUL byte.

### Envelope

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `formatVersion` | integer 1..=1 | yes | Envelope format. |
| `keyId` | text ≤ `MAX_KEY_ID_BYTES` | yes | Signing key ID: `[a-z0-9._-]`; production IDs are `overcrow-widgets-YYYY-NN`. |
| `payload` | `Base64url` | yes | Canonical unpadded Base64url of the payload bytes, at most `MAX_CATALOG_PAYLOAD_BYTES` decoded. |
| `signature` | `Base64url` | yes | Canonical unpadded Base64url of the 64-byte Ed25519 signature of the domain string followed by the payload bytes. |

### Catalog payload

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `formatVersion` | integer 1..=1 | yes | Catalog format. |
| `sequence` | integer 1..=9007199254740991 | yes | Anti-rollback sequence of the v1 catalog, started at 1 and independent of the Web catalog. |
| `generatedAt` | `UTC timestamp` | yes | `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. |
| `expiresAt` | `UTC timestamp` | yes | After `generatedAt`, at most `MAX_CATALOG_LIFETIME_DAYS` later in production. |
| `targets` | list of `Target` ≤ `MAX_CATALOG_TARGETS` | yes | Listed package versions, unique by ID and version. |

### Seed payload

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `formatVersion` | integer 1..=1 | yes | Seed format. |
| `catalogSequence` | integer 1..=9007199254740991 | yes | Sequence of the live catalog the seed was cut from. |
| `generatedAt` | `UTC timestamp` | yes | `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`. |
| `expiresAt` | `UTC timestamp` | yes | After `generatedAt`, at most `MAX_SEED_LIFETIME_DAYS` later. |
| `targets` | list of `Target` ≤ `MAX_CATALOG_TARGETS` | yes | `built-in` targets with status `verified` only, as listed by that catalog. |

### `Target`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `manifest` | `manifest` | yes | The package's manifest object, validated as v1; the package must contain an equal one. |
| `tags` | `list of tags` | no | Distinct tags from the closed set. |
| `status` | `verified` \| `security-suspended` \| `revoked` | yes | `verified` may be installed; `security-suspended` and `revoked` may not, and stop an installed copy. |
| `package` | `PackageRef` | yes | Immutable archive. |
| `listing` | `Listing` | yes | Marketplace text. |
| `preview` | `Preview` | no | PNG preview. |

### `PackageRef`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | text ≤ `MAX_CATALOG_URL_BYTES` | yes | Exactly `<base>packages/<id>/<version>/<sha256>.ocpkg`. |
| `size` | integer 1..=16777216 | yes | Archive bytes. |
| `sha256` | `lowercase hex SHA-256` | yes | Archive digest. |

### `Listing`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `author` | text ≤ `MAX_AUTHOR_BYTES` | yes | Plain text, trimmed, without `<` or `>`. |
| `spdxLicense` | text ≤ `MAX_SPDX_LICENSE_BYTES` | yes | SPDX expression characters `[A-Za-z0-9.+-]`. |
| `sourceUrl` | text ≤ `MAX_CATALOG_URL_BYTES` | yes | Canonical HTTPS URL of the reviewed source, without port, query or fragment. |
| `defaultLocale` | `locale` | yes | One of the localizations. |
| `localizations` | list of `Localization` ≤ `MAX_LISTING_LOCALIZATIONS` | yes | `{ locale, name, description }` with distinct `xx` or `xx-YY` locales; name ≤ `MAX_LISTING_NAME_BYTES`, description ≤ `MAX_LISTING_DESCRIPTION_BYTES`. |

### `Preview`

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `url` | text ≤ `MAX_CATALOG_URL_BYTES` | yes | Exactly `<base>previews/<id>/<version>/<sha256>.png`. |
| `mediaType` | `image/png` | yes | Media type. |
| `size` | integer 1..=262144 | yes | Image bytes. |
| `sha256` | `lowercase hex SHA-256` | yes | Image digest. |

### Tags

| Tag | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `built-in` | PlayerVox reference widget: installed by default from the live catalog or the offline seed, with default consent to its declared permissions (ADR 0001, D7). Accepted only for `com.playervox.*` IDs, on every listed version of the ID. |
